description: Agentic tool to create a new meeting scheduling poll in Candidate Slots mode (slots) or Drag-to-Paint Availability Grid mode (grid), with candidate dates, time slots or earliest/latest range, duration/block size, and optional invitee emails

block_size.description: Grid mode block size in minutes (15, 30, or 60)

creator_timezone_offset.description: Creator timezone offset in minutes (e.g. -120 for UTC+2)

description.description: Optional meeting description, agenda, or context

earliest.description: Grid mode earliest boundary time in HH:mm format

invitee_emails.description: Optional list of invitee emails to auto-send invitations to

latest.description: Grid mode latest boundary time in HH:mm format (up to 24:00)

poll_mode.description: Poll mode: "slots" for discrete candidate start times or "grid" for continuous drag-to-paint availability grid

time_slots.description: Candidate start times in HH:mm format (optional in grid mode when earliest/latest are supplied)

name: create_meeting_poll
